senses.gloss: Śrutaśravas^1, a ṛshi. § 13 (Paushyap.): I, 3, ††674 (father of Somaśravas, the purohita of Janamejaya).--§ 59 (Sarpasattra): I, 53, 2049 (among the sadasyas at the snake-sacrifice of Janamejaya, C. has Śrutaśruvas).--§ 702 (Mokshadh.): XII, 293, 10762.
Śrutaśravas^2, a rājarshi. § 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 319 (in the palace of Yama).
Śrutaśrī, a Daitya. § 564 (Mātalīyop.): V, 105, 3685 (had been slain by Garuḍa).
Śrutaśruvas, v. Śrutaśravas^1.
Śrutadhvaja, a Pāṇḍava warrior. § 600 (Ghaṭotkacavadhap.): VII, 158, 7011 (brother of Virāṭa?).
Śrutāhvaya, v. Śrutāyus^4.

Śrutakarman^1, son of Sahadeva and Draupadī. § 159 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 95, ††3827.--§ 317 (Arjunābhigamanap.): III, 12, 534.--§ 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 45^19, 1735 (Sāhadevaṃ), 1736 (fights Sudakshiṇa).--§ 583 (do.): VI, 79^13, 3482, 3484 (fights Durmukha).--§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 23, 981 (description of his horses; PCR. says that Ś. here is the son of Bhīmasena, but this (Sutasoma) is mentioned v. 976); 25, 1090 (fights Caitraseni).--§ 605 (Karṇap.): VIII, 13, 493 (fights Citrasena, the Abhishāra king); 14, 526 (do.), 527, 534, 535, 537 (slays Citrasena), 544.--§ 608 (do.): VIII, 55, 2664, 2667 (fights Aśvatthāman).--§ 616 (Sauptikap.): X, 8, 377, 378 (is slain by Aśvatthāman). Cf. Śrutasena^3, Draupadeya.

Śrutakarman^2, son of Arjuna and Draupadī. § 253 (Haraṇāharaṇap.): I, 221, 8039, 8043 (origin of the name: śrutaṃ karma mahat kṛtvā nivṛttena Kirīṭinā).--§ 511 (Draupadī-Satyabhāmasaṃv.): III, 235, 14731. Cf. Śrutakīrti.
Śrutakarman^3, son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 605 (Karṇap.): VIII, 25, 1005 (fights Śatānīka).

Śrutakīrt(t)i, son of. Arjuna and Draupadī. § 83 (Ādivaṃśāvatāraṇa): I, 63, 2451.--§ 130 (Aṃcāvat.): I, 67, 2763 (the sons of Draupadī are incarnations of the Viśvadevas).--§ 159 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 95, ††3827.--§ 317 (Arjunābhigamanap.): III, 12, 533.--§ 583 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 79^13, 3487 (fights Jayatsena), 3488.-§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 23, 982 (Draupadeyaṃ, description of his horses); 25, 1095 (Ārjuniṃ, fights the son of Duḥśāsana).--§ 605 (Karṇap.): VIII, 13, 496 (attacks Śalya); 14, 530 (cf. Nīl., but should not we read Śrutakarmā as PCR. has it?); 25, 1032.--§ 608 (do.): VIII, 49, 2363; 55, 2664, 2667, 2669.--§ 616 (Sauptikap.): X, 8, 379 (slain by Aśvatthāman). Cf. Ārjuni, Śrutakarman^2, Draupadeya.
Śrutānīka, a Pāṇḍava warrior. § 600 (Ghaṭotkacavadhap.): VII, 158, 7011 (brother of Virāṭa?).
Śrutānta, son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 611 (Śalyap.): IX, 26, 1404 (among the eleven sons of Dhṛtarāshṭra who attacked Bhīmasena), 1411 (slain by Bhīmasena).
Śrutarvan^1, a king. § 382 (Agastyop.): III, 98, 8595, 8601, 8606.

Śrutarvan^2, son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 51, 2446 (C. has Śrutavān).--§ 611 (Śalyap.): IX, 26, 1406 (among the eleven sons of Dhṛtarāshṭra who attacked Bhīmasena), 1413, 1421, 1427, 1431 (slain by Bhīmasena).
Śrutasena^1, brother of Janamejaya Pārikshita. § 12 (Paushyap.): I, 3, ††662.

Śrutasena^2, a serpent. § 17 (Uttaṅka): I, 3, 804 (jaghanyajas Takshakaś ca Śrutaseneti yaḥ sutaḥ | avasad yo Mahadyumni prārthayan nāgamukhyataṃ, the true reading seems to be Takshakasya (“the younger brother of Takshaka,” PCR.).

Śrutasena^3, son of Sahadeva and Draupadī. § 83 (Ādivaṃśāvatāraṇa): I, 63, 2452.--§ 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2763 (the sons of Draupadī were incarnations of the Viśvadevas).--§ 253 (Haraṇāharaṇap.): I, 221, 8040, 8045 (origin of the name: ajījanat Kṛshṇā nakshatre Vahnidaivate).-§ 511 (Draupadī-Satyabhāmāsaṃv.): III, 235, 14732. Cf. Śrutakarman^1.
Śrutasena^4, a Daitya. § 564 (Mātalīyop.): V, 105, 3685 (had been slain by Garuḍa).
Śrutasena^5, a Kuru warrior. § 605 (Karṇap.): VIII, 27, 1087 (= Citrasena, v. 1078?).
Śrutasoma, v. Sutasema.
Śrutavat, v. Śrutarvan^2.

Śrutāvatī, daughter of Bharadvāja. § 615y (Badarapācana): IX, 48, 2763, 2821 (Bharadvājasya duhitā, performed austerities at Badarapācana, gratified Indra by her persevering in boiling five badara-fruits, and became the wife of Indra).--§ 615 (Baladevat.): the viprarshi Bharadvāja saw the Apsaras Ghṛtācī, then his vital seed came out. He caught it in his hand, and then kept it in a funnel of a leaf (parṇapuṭe); from that seed was born a girl, whom he in the presence of D. and R. called Ś. Keeping the girl in his hermitage, Bharadvāja repaired to the forest of Himavat: IX, 48, 2829.

Śrutāyudha^1, king of the Kaliṅgas. § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 121 (Kāliṅgaḥ, among the kings who were present when Yudhishṭhira entered his palace).--§ 576 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 16, 623 (Kāliṅgaḥ, in Duryodhana's army); 17, 657. Cf. Śrutāyus^2, Kaliṅga, Kāliṅga, Kaliṅgādhipati, Kaliṅgaka.

Śrutāyudha^2, a king. § 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 92, 3295 (fights Arjuna), 3301 3303, 3304, 3310 (c) (Ś. was the son of Varuṇa and the river Parṇāśā; at the request of Parṇāśā, Varuṇa had given him a mace and mantras, by means of which he would be invincible in battle, if he did not hurl it at anyone who was not engaged in fighting, for then it would come back and slay himself), 3312, 3314 (Ś. hurled his mace at Kṛshṇa, who did not fight and was himself slain), 3315, 3317, 3320, 3337; 93, 3338 (hate); 94, 3410 (nihate Savyasācinā(!)), 3438 (nihataḥ).--§ 611 (Śalyap.): IX, 24, 1297 (hate).

Śrutāyu(s)^1, king of the Ambashṭhas. [The quotations not mentioning Ambashṭha or the like might also refer to Śrutāyus^2--3.]
§ 11 (Parvasaṅgr.): I, 2, 535.--§ 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2700 (among the kings who were incarnations from the Krodhavaśagaṇa).--§ 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 7001 (present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī). § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 123 (among the kings who were present when Yudhishṭhira entered his palace).--§ 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 4, 86 (among the princes to whom the Pāṇḍavas ought to send messengers).-§ 561 (Yānasandhip.): V, 55, 2207 (in the army of Duryodhana).--§ 571 (Ulūkadūtāg.): V, 160, †5531 (Śrutāyu-Hārddikya-mahāsamudraṃ, sc. puroshodadhiṃ, i.e. the army of Duryodhana; the half-śloka is wanting in B.).-§ 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 45^20, 1737, 1739 (fights Irāvat); 51, 2108 (on the right flank of Duryodhana's army).--§ 580 (do.): VI, 59, †2584 (Ambashṭhapatiḥ, attacks Arjuna), (), †2647 (do., vanquished by Arjuna).-§ 583 (do.): VI, 75, 3298 (in the rear of Bhīshma's krauñcavyūha).--§ 584 (do.): VI, 81^1, 3562 (attacked by Yudhishṭhira); 84, 3696, 3697, 3702, 3709, 3712 (vanquished by Yudhishṭhira).--§ 586 (do.): VI, 99, 4506 (in the rear of Bhīshma's sarvatobhadra array); 102, 4667 (attacks Bhīmasena).--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 91, 3253 (resists Arjuna); 93, 3397 (Ambashṭhaḥ, is slain by Arjuna); 94, 3437 (all. to chap. 93).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 5, 107 (Ambashṭhaḥ, mentioned as slain), 115 (the same?).-§ 611 (Śalyap.): IX, 24, 1297 (hate). Cf. Ambashṭha, Ambashṭhapati.
Śrutāyus^2 = Śrutāyudha, the Kaliṅga king. § 579 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 54, 2240 (attacks Bhīmasena, his son Śakradeva is slain by Bhīmasena), 2301, 2305 (is slain by Bhīmasena). Cf. Śrutāyus^1.

Śrutāyus^3, brother(?) of Acyutāyus. § 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 93, 3344 (Śºś cācyutāyuś ca, attack Arjuna), 3348, 3362 (with Acyutāyus he is slain by Bhīmasena), 3364 (Ś. and Acyutāyus' sons are Niyatāyus and Dīrghāyus); 94, 3438 (all. to chap. 93).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 72, 3613 (all. to § 599). Cf. Śrutāyus^1.
Śrutāyus^4, a Pāṇḍava warrior. § 600 (Ghaṭotkacavadhap.): VII, 156, 6913 (is slain by Aśvatthāman; B. has Śrutāhvayaṃ).
Śrutāyus^5, a Kuru warrior. § 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 7, †209 (among the remnants of Duryodhana's army).
Śruti, an ancient king. § 6 (Anukram.): I, 1, 232 (in Sañjaya's enumeration of kings who have died).
Śrutisāgara = Vishṇu (1000 names).
Śrutivarman, a Kuru warrior. § 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 7, †207 (among the remnants of Duryodhana's army).
Sruvahasta = Śiva: XIII, 1157 (1000 names^2); XIV, 200.
